examShortTricks: Trick 1: Branches in one line each: dairy (milk), poultry (eggs/meat), apiculture (bees/honey), pisciculture (fish), sericulture (silk) — five branches with products.
Trick 2: Cattle breeds: exotic high-yield (Jersey, Holstein-Friesian) vs indigenous hardy (Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi); cross-breeding combines both — the two-column answer.
Trick 3: Poultry breeds: layers vs broilers; improved breeds need feed, hygiene, vaccination — management triad.
Trick 4: Bee-keeping: Apis indica common; Italian bee A. mellifera high honey yield; apiary location near flowers — the apiculture specifics.
